items.original:
STRATEGIC ADVISORY

All Helldivers should factor the following advisory into their strategic decision-making:

Enemy forces stage their attacks on our planets from an originating planet. Liberating the originating planet will end the enemy attack immediately.

In the current operational context, liberating HERTHON SECUNDUS would end the current Illuminate attack on ZEA RUGOSIA.
items.translated:
战略预警

全体绝地潜兵在做战略决策时都应该考虑以下建议：

敌人从起源星球向我们的领地发起进攻。解放起源星球将立即终止敌人的攻势。

在当前情况下，解放赫尔松次星就能终止当前Illuminate向泽亚鲁戈西亚发起的进攻。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER 

The first SEAF personnel have reported to the newly completed CMC for their wellness leave and mandatory neural implant surgery. Helldivers must defend ZEA RUGOSIA and the CMC as SEAF undergo the medical procedure and legally mandated minimum recovery time. Helldivers are ordered to liberate HERTHON SECUNDUS and HEZE BAY to prepare for the planetary campaigns on ALAMAK VII and ALAIRT III.
items.translated:
新重要指令

首批SEAF人员已前往新建成的CMC报到，准备进行健康休假，还要接受强制神经植入手术。在SEAF接受医疗程序，以及度过法定强制的最短恢复期时，绝地潜兵必须守住泽亚鲁戈西亚和CMC。绝地潜兵奉命解放赫尔松次星和角宿二湾，为天大将军一VII及艾列尔特III的行星战役做准备。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON 

The Helldivers eliminated the specified targets with Democratic zeal and exemplary obedience. The materials extracted from the fallen enemies will be prepared for production. A portion of the cost savings will be forwarded to the Helldivers in the form of a free Orbital Napalm Barrage, available for the next 48 hours.

重要指令已完成

绝地潜兵表现出了民主热情和堪称典范的服从，消灭了指定目标。从阵亡敌人身上提取的材料都会投入生产。节省下的一部分成本会转化为免费的轨道凝固汽油弹火力网，发放给绝地潜兵，在接下来的48小时内可用。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER 

The continuing Voteless surges require vastly more SEAF to be sent planetside, increasing demand for the production of the neural implants. To lower the project's economic impact, Helldivers are ordered to eliminate 135,000,000 Troopers, 2,000,000 Factory Striders, 250,000,000 of Terminids and 25,000,000 Bile Spewers.
items.translated:
新重要指令

无票者持续激增，需要将大量SEAF送往行星地表，因此，神经植入物的生产需求飙升。为了降低该项目的经济影响，绝地潜兵奉命消灭135,000,000名新兵、2,000,000座移动工厂、250,000,000只终结族以及25,000,000只胆汁喷涌虫。

SYSTEM OUTAGE UPDATE
Some Helldivers may have noticed a recent service error in the Major Order Communication Display. The issue has since been resolved (details below).
[SYSTEM ERROR REPORT #8.03.529]
Cause: Stray bullet hit central data relay.
Discussion: Truth Enforcer in-field execution had dissident facing the wrong wall.
Resolution: Electronics replaced. Family of dissident fined for damages. 
[END REPORT]
items.translated:
系统故障更新
部分绝地潜兵可能已注意到，重要指令通讯显示屏近期出现服务错误。该问题现已解决（详情见下）。
[系统错误报告 #8.03.529]
原因：流弹击中中央数据中继器。
讨论：真理执行者现场处决时，让异见分子面错了墙。
处理：电子元件已更换。异见分子家属因损坏设备被处以罚款。
[报告结束]

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON 

Both orders were successful and as a result, construction of the CMC began on schedule and without issue. Early reports from the mental health initiatives show promise, with SEAF personnel especially appreciating therapeutic activities such as the Illuminate live-fire range. The neural implant tested well at the prototype phase and will move to full production immediately.
items.translated:
重要指令已完成

两项指令均已成功，因此，CMC的建设会按计划顺利开始。心智健康倡议的早期报告显示出了积极的前景，SEAF人员特别赞赏了光能者实弹射击场等治疗活动。神经植入物在原型阶段的测试结果良好，将会立即进入全面生产。

NEW MAJOR ORDER 

Helldivers are ordered to hold ZEA RUGOSIA, the planetary base for the Center for Mental Clarity (CMC). 

Helldivers are also ordered to kill 215,000,000 Voteless to develop the experimental therapeutic program. The Ministry of Truth knows that the Helldivers will rise to the occasion.

新重要指令

绝地潜兵奉命坚守泽亚鲁戈西亚，即心智澄明中心（CMC）的行星基地。

绝地潜兵还需击杀215,000,000名无票者，协助开发实验性治疗项目。真理部坚信，绝地潜兵一定能迎难而上。

items.original:
DSS BACK TO REGULAR OPERATION

The DSS is resuming standard operation procedures at the hands of the Helldivers after having concluded authorized FIREBREAK PROTOCOL across the surface of GACRUX.

Helldivers can now resume collective control of the Democracy Space Station via the Galactic Map. Use it to defend our way of life and Managed Democracy.
items.translated:
民主空间站恢复常规运作

经授权，火线阻断协议已在十字架一地表执行完毕。此后，民主空间站将回归绝地潜兵掌控，恢复标准运作流程。

绝地潜兵现可通过银河地图，重新集体控制民主空间站。用它捍卫我们的生活方式，捍卫受控民主。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER FAILED

Though the Helldivers successfully repelled the primary Terminid swarm, the uncooperative fascist insects prevented the full deployment of the Firebreak Protocol, with fewer Terminid-infested planets purged of their affliction than intended.

In response, full production of the Incinerator FRV has commenced, to be ready for when the mutated strain of Terminids next raises its ugly head.

未完成重要指令

尽管绝地潜兵成功击退了终结族虫群的主力，但顽固不化的法西斯昆虫还是阻碍了防火带协议的全面部署，导致已清除终结族侵扰的星球数量低于预期。

items.original:
DSS FIREBREAK PROTOCOL

The planetary purification of ACAMAR IV has reached satisfactory levels. With orbital firing corridors now secured above GACRUX, the DSS will continue FIREBREAK PROTOCOL there until similar sanitation levels are achieved.

Helldivers are expected to regain control of the DSS once FIREBREAK PROTOCOL is complete.
items.translated:
DSS 防火协议

天园六IV 的星球净化已达到令人满意的水平。随着 十字架一 上空的轨道射击走廊现已得到保障，DSS 将在该地继续执行防火协议，直至达到同等卫生水平。

防火协议完成后，绝地潜兵应重新夺回 DSS 的控制权。
